claims.text: GitLab (по его отчёту): 31 января 2017 сбой из-за случайного удаления данных на основном сервере БД
claims.quote: The outage was caused by an accidental removal of data from our primary database server.

claims.text: Инженер стёр каталог БД на основном сервере вместо вторичного, успели удалить около 300 ГБ
claims.quote: The engineer terminated the process a second or two after noticing their mistake, but at this point around 300 GB of data had already been removed.

claims.text: Потеряны данные примерно по 5000 проектов, 5000 комментариям и 700 новым аккаунтам
claims.quote: Our best estimate is that it affected roughly 5,000 projects, 5,000 comments and 700 new user accounts.

claims.text: Бакет S3 с pg_dump бэкапами оказался пустым
claims.quote: The S3 bucket was empty, and there was no recent backup to be found anywhere.
the backup procedure was using pg_dump 9.2, while our database is running PostgreSQL 9.6

claims.text: Письма об ошибках cron отклонялись, о сбое бэкапов не знали
claims.quote: Unfortunately DMARC was not enabled for the cronjob emails, resulting in them being rejected by the receiver.

claims.text: Снимки Azure не были включены для серверов БД
claims.quote: While enabled for the NFS servers, these snapshots were not enabled for any of the database servers

claims.text: Отчёт GitLab: сервис GitLab.com пережил крупный сбой
claims.quote: we experienced a major service outage for one of our products, the online service GitLab.com.
